def analyze(g):
    res=[]
    for c in comps(g):
        ys=[p[0] for p in c]; xs=[p[1] for p in c]
        h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1; n=len(c)
        sub=[[1 if (y,x) in c else 0 for x in range(min(xs),min(xs)+w)] for y in range(min(ys),min(ys)+h)]
        def sym(f):
            return sub==[[f(r[i] if False else 0) for i in range(w)] for r in []] if False else None
        T=[list(r) for r in zip(*sub)]
        hs = sub==[r[::-1] for r in sub]
        vs = sub==sub[::-1]
        rot180 = sub==[r[::-1] for r in sub[::-1]]
        diag = sub==T
        adiag = all(sub[w-1-j][h-1-i]==sub[i][j] for i in range(h) for j in range(w))
        # holes: zeros not reachable from border of bbox
        import collections
        st=[(i,j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if sub[i][j]==0 and (i in(0,h-1) or j in(0,w-1))]
        seen=set(st)
        while st:
            y,x=st.pop()
            for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                if 0<=ny<h and 0<=nx<w and sub[ny][nx]==0 and (ny,nx) not in seen:
                    seen.add((ny,nx)); st.append((ny,nx))
        holes=sum(1 for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if sub[i][j]==0 and (i,j) not in seen)
        # perimeter (edges between cell and non-cell/outside)
        per=sum(1 for (y,x) in c for dy,dx in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)) if (y+dy,x+dx) not in c)
        res.append((n,h,w,n/(h*w),holes,per,hs,vs,rot180,diag,adiag))
